description:
The default AI run triple stored at team or user level.

Write payload for the tasks config endpoints and the `ai_run_preferences` block of
their responses. `runtime_adapter` and `model` must be set together; send all three
as null to clear a stored preference.

model.description: Default LLM model identifier for new task runs. Must be set together with `runtime_adapter` on the acp arm, or with `runtime` on the pi arm.

anyOf.description:
* `low` - low
* `medium` - medium
* `high` - high
* `xhigh` - xhigh
* `max` - max
* `ultracode` - ultracode

reasoning_effort.description:
Default reasoning effort for models that expose an effort control.

* `low` - low
* `medium` - medium
* `high` - high
* `xhigh` - xhigh
* `max` - max
* `ultracode` - ultracode

runtime.description:
Agent runtime this preference launches. 'acp' (the default, matching rows stored before this field) pairs `runtime_adapter` with `model`; 'pi' forbids `runtime_adapter` and requires `model`.

* `acp` - ACP
* `pi` - Pi

runtime_adapter.description:
Default agent runtime adapter for new task runs. Use 'claude' for the Claude runtime or 'codex' for the Codex runtime. Must be set together with `model`, and left null when `runtime` is 'pi'.

* `claude` - claude
* `codex` - codex
